This is an accurate refutation of that printed claim, whose canonical note identifies it as false; no equal-individual-means condition is inserted. A family of disjoint C4 graphs, alternating means +/-1, independent noise +/-1/4, and unit weights satisfies Scaling with (c1,c2,c3,c4)=(2,2,1/16,2). Its n-scaled V1 is at most -5/16 on every supported outcome while n*true variance is 1/16. Thus the absolute error exceeds 1/4 with probability one.
